label: v201
changes: Asking a second question about the same document is now much faster. Your phone was re-scanning every page of the document from scratch on every single question — the slowest part of the whole thing — to produce pages the server had already read and saved. It now checks first, and skips straight to the answer.
This is what made a read time out and give up on a long scanned lease, even though the answer was ready.
